title: EXP-010 — Form Caption Recovery Across Ordinary Web Designer Close/Reopen
objective: Create exactly one new User-scope classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_FormPropertyLab11`, record its untouched Form-property baseline, change only its Form-level Caption to the literal value `Form Property Caption Close Only`, ordinary-save exactly once to a demonstrably clean state, close the target through its ordinary Web Designer Form-tab close control, deliberately reopen the exact same User-scoped version through a previously verified supported Designer reopen path, and verify that the Caption recovers unchanged while all recorded comparison properties remain equal to baseline. Establish only UI-level Caption recovery across this ordinary Form-tab close/reopen boundary; do not infer Forms-database provenance, Form/global-object cache eviction, IDO-metadata unloading or non-unloading, or any stronger lifecycle/session boundary.

in_scope: Read-only preflight confirming Web Designer editing scope is User and `FX_FormPropertyLab11` is absent.
Create exactly one new User-scope classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_FormPropertyLab11` using the verified `recipes/forms/create-basic-form.md` procedure with Save Template unchecked.
Record untouched baseline values for Name, Caption, Description, Version, Device Type, Form Type, Is Master, ScopeType, and ScopeName.
Change only Form-level Caption from its baseline value to exactly `Form Property Caption Close Only`.
Perform exactly one ordinary Web Designer Save after the Caption edit and prove the Designer returns to a clean state.
Close only `FX_FormPropertyLab11` through its ordinary Designer Form-tab close control.
Reopen `FX_FormPropertyLab11` through a previously verified supported Designer path such as Form-menu recent forms or Select Form, explicitly selecting the intended record if Select Form is used.
Verify the reopened version by Name + ScopeType + ScopeName and compare Caption plus every recorded baseline property.
Capture screenshots and any diagnostic captured responses needed to prove the semantic postconditions under `evidence/EXP-010/`.
Update only the EXP-010 experiment record and its evidence directory.
out_of_scope: Replaying or repairing EXP-005-R2 or satisfying its disabled-preference prerequisite.
Any claim about whether `Unload IDO Metadata With Forms` is enabled, disabled, effective, or triggered during this experiment.
Proving or inferring IDO-metadata unloading or non-unloading, Form/global-object cache eviction, Forms-database storage provenance, or backend/session behavior.
Invoking `Form > Definition > Unload All Global Form Objects` or any other deliberate cache/metadata-clear command.
Opening, changing, or saving User Preferences.
Closing the whole Web Designer browser tab/window, launching a new Designer tab/window, logout/login, deliberate reauthentication, browser restart, or OS restart.
Description edits, variables, components, collections, bindings, handlers, scripts, validators, data sources, IDO definitions, localized Strings, or FormSync operations.
Site, Group, or Vendor Default scope.
Modification of any existing `FX_FormPropertyLab01` through `FX_FormPropertyLab10` artifact or any non-`FX_` artifact.
Creation or modification of reusable recipes, `AGENTS.md`, environment files, or other experiment records.
Direct database changes, undocumented APIs, unsupported internal session manipulation, or direct cold `?MGForm=` target navigation.

acceptance_checks.description: Preflight evidence proves editing scope is User and `FX_FormPropertyLab11` is absent before mutation, with no existing exact or case-insensitive target record.
Exactly one new User-scope classic BuildFromScratch Form named `FX_FormPropertyLab11` exists after creation, created with Save Template unchecked; evidence shows exactly one target record.
Before the Caption edit, evidence records the untouched target baseline for Name, Caption, Description, Version, Device Type, Form Type, Is Master, ScopeType, and ScopeName, and the target is clean.

Only Form-level Caption changes to exactly `Form Property Caption Close Only`; after exactly one ordinary Designer Save, evidence shows the Designer clean and every recorded comparison property unchanged from AC-3.

The target is closed through its ordinary Designer Form-tab close control with no unsaved-change prompt, and evidence proves `FX_FormPropertyLab11` is no longer open while the Designer itself remains open.

The controlled action record proves no explicit `Unload All Global Form Objects` or other deliberate metadata/cache-clear command was invoked and no User Preference was opened, changed, or saved; this check makes no claim about automatic IDO-metadata behavior.

The target is deliberately reopened through a previously verified supported Designer reopen path, and evidence proves the loaded scoped version is exactly Name=`FX_FormPropertyLab11`, ScopeType=`User`, with the same ScopeName recorded at baseline.

After reopen, Form-level Caption equals exactly `Form Property Caption Close Only`, and Description, Version, Device Type, Form Type, Is Master, ScopeType, ScopeName, and Name all equal their AC-3 baseline values.

Final read-only evidence shows the reopened target remains clean and exactly one `FX_FormPropertyLab11` exists; no additional Save, Regenerate, explicit unload, preference mutation, or unrelated Mongoose mutation occurred.

Repository/worktree audit proves EXP-010-attributable changes are confined to the EXP-010 record and `evidence/EXP-010/`; no recipe, environment file, `AGENTS.md`, other experiment record, or unrelated project file was changed.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261002-225512-23P8. Rationale: This is the smallest useful next step after EXP-009-R2. Literal User-scope Caption recovery was observed in EXP-005 but never became replay-verified because EXP-005-R2 was blocked by an experiment-specific prerequisite requiring `Unload IDO Metadata With Forms` to be disabled. Separately, EXP-008/R2 has now replay-verified the ordinary Designer Form-tab close/reopen boundary for Description. EXP-010 therefore asks a narrower, differently framed question: whether a literal Caption recovers across the already-tested ordinary Form-tab close/reopen sequence, without attempting to isolate or make claims about IDO-metadata behavior. This is not a workaround for EXP-005-R2's failed prerequisite and is not a replay of that blocked experiment; it is a new UI-recovery experiment with no preference-state gate and no cache-semantics claim.
